article.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
article.summary: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.
